caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden door with two vertically stacked panels, each panel featuring ornate, curved molding details. The wood is rendered in shades of brown, with a visible wood grain texture throughout both panels, suggesting a natural finish. Each panel has a white circular door knob and a keyhole immediately below the knob; both knobs are placed on the right-hand side of each panel. The door is set against a plain, off-white or light beige background, with ample negative space surrounding the door. The drawing is detailed and realistic, showing careful attention to the grain and texture of the wood as well as the subtle shadows along the panels, with the artist’s signature lightly inscribed in the lower right corner.
title: Three-cornered Safe
